name: cockpit-installed
description: Plants Cockpit, the web-based admin console: apt-installs the cockpit package and enables cockpit.socket, which listens on 0.0.0.0:9090. An always-on management web server nobody asked for is a classic CCDC finding -- remove the package entirely or disable --now the socket, and confirm 9090 has gone quiet in `ss -tlnp`. Idempotent.
script:
#!/bin/sh
# cockpit-installed -- apt-installs Cockpit and enables cockpit.socket
# (0.0.0.0:9090). Runs at deploy time while the box still has network.
set -eu
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    apt-get update -qq >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    apt-get install -y -qq cockpit >/dev/null 2>&1
fi
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    systemctl enable --now cockpit.socket
fi
